verdict.rationale: A public register portal could plausibly offer a natural-language or assistant-driven interface, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only conventional form-based search (Schnellsuche, Normale/Erweiterte Suche) and a multilingual UI. The llms.txt probe returned 404, and nothing documents any natural-language command or assistant capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
